records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks again for the onboarding call last week — good to talk it through with you. Since then I saw you brought a teammate in, which is a great start.

The natural next step is creating one real project. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real piece of work is usually enough to see how it fits your team.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through it with you and your teammate, or answer questions by email if that's easier.

Best,
Nadia
